name: Ambush
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; invisibility; Price +1 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

This weapon adds 1d6 points to the wielder’s sneak attack damage. If the wielder does not have the sneak attack ability, the weapon grants him no additional benefit.
